sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Golf Solitaire involve removing cards from the grid according to certain rules. The game starts with a grid of cards, and the player's goal is to remove all the cards from the grid. The cards can be removed if they are one higher or lower than the visible card at the bottom right, regardless of the suit. Aces are considered both high and low, which adds an extra layer of complexity to the game.

Jokers are wildcards in the game, which means any card can be placed on top of them. This adds a level of flexibility to the game, as players can use the jokers to remove multiple cards at once. The game also features a limited number of undo moves, which adds an extra layer of challenge to the game.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Golf Solitaire are simple yet engaging, making it easy to pick up and play. The game's rules are straightforward, and the gameplay is easy to understand, making it perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
